shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure carved in relief on a vertical stone monument
elaborate headdress or headgear above the face
low-relief carving covering the whole visible surface
circular disc or medallion on the torso area
bands of ornament crossing the surface horizontally
justification: Both surfaces show a frontal anthropomorphic being with a massive elaborated headdress occupying the upper zone, a chest ornament/disc, and low-relief curvilinear scrollwork filling the field on an upright monument, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. However, A is a sculpted three-dimensional body with sparse, broad incised motifs and a plain lower zone, while B is densely packed with small interlocking glyph-like panels, multiple subsidiary faces and a full standing figure below, so the density and number of depicted elements differ markedly.
